evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies wallet broadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and updates wallet rebroadcast functional tests.
rationale: Suppressing rebroadcasts for transactions already present in the local mempool plugs a significant privacy leak where redundant announcements signal node ownership to peers. As noted in the discussion, this addresses a long-standing privacy issue (#3828, #36403) by avoiding unconditional relays that tie user IPs to specific wallet transactions.
